what: final-bail-reason persistence wired only into refresh-run-logs.sh but that script is not invoked from run_postmerge_phase after write_finalize_state writes the file; exit-3 cap bail never calls write_finalize_state either

suggested_fix: Extend plan with a ship-pr (or orchestrator) hook: e.g. call refresh-run-logs after write_finalize_state in postmerge and/or write final-bail-reason.txt plus larch-log write on user-bail before exit 3; drop or narrow the no ship-pr.sh change constraint if persistence is required

what: STALL_STEP 10-max-retries is reused for unrelated caps (vendor evaluate_failure exhaustion vs rebase storm cap)

what: Plan claims larch-log write failures surface as execution-issues Warnings while prescribing stderr suppression like existing token/timing lines
